changelog:
Initial release of the API Test Plan skill.

- Generates comprehensive API test plans covering functional, contract, negative, and non-functional cases.
- Outputs structured test cases per endpoint, including status codes, schema checks, auth, validation, and error handling.
- Provides guidance for inferring missing API details and ensures all critical paths (not just 200 responses) are tested.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to support thorough, real-world API verification.
- Offers concise non-functional notes (rate limits, pagination, security) and setup guidance.
summary: Plan tests for an API endpoint or service — functional, negative, and contract. Use when asked to test an API, write API test cases, plan REST/GraphQL endpoi...
